item.title: His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani was received with military honours on the Bundesplatz in Bern, on the first state visit by a Q…
item.description:
His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani was received with military honours on the Bundesplatz in Bern, on the first state visit by a Qatari head of state to Switzerland, then held official talks with Swiss President Guy Parmelin at the Bernerhof, joined by the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister and the ministers of finance and energy. Addressing the Federal Council and Federal Assembly, the Amir described the partnership as built on trust and mutual respect and looked to expand trade and investment in the knowledge economy, energy and healthcare, stressing that regional stability requires dialogue, respect for sovereignty and international law, and the protection of civilians. Parmelin praised Qatar's mediation and its accession as a partner state to the OSCE.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/amir-swiss-president-hold-official-talks-session · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/amir-visits-swiss-parliament · blue News (bluewin) https://www.bluewin.ch/en/news/the-emir-of-qatar-was-received-in-bern-with-military-honors-li.3678315

item.title: At the end of its staff visit to Doha (3 to 12 November), the IMF raised its 2026 assessment of Qatar's economy to a contraction of about 1…
item.description:
At the end of its staff visit to Doha (3 to 12 November), the IMF raised its 2026 assessment of Qatar's economy to a contraction of about 14.5%, some 1.1 percentage points shallower than its October forecast, with growth expected to resume from 2027 as LNG output recovers and to average about 6% in 2028–31. It put inflation at about 3.5% this year, noted non-hydrocarbon growth of about 3% in the first half, and low non-performing loans at 3.2% with provisioning cover of about 80%. Mission chief Nathan Porter said Qatar is "navigating a severe hydrocarbon shock from a position of strength".
Sources: Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/business/imf-raises-qatars-2026-gdp-forecast-sees-145-contraction-3012672 · Mirage News (IMF statement) https://www.miragenews.com/imf-staff-concludes-visit-to-qatar-1778842/

item.title: The Interior Ministry presented the new Traffic Law No. 19 of 2026, published in the Official Gazette, at a news conference. It requires el…
item.description:
The Interior Ministry presented the new Traffic Law No. 19 of 2026, published in the Official Gazette, at a news conference. It requires electric scooters to be registered, fees paid and plates fitted before use, makes helmets mandatory for scooter and motorcycle riders, and raises the minimum age for a motorcycle licence from 18 to 21. Riding an unregistered scooter carries up to three months in prison or a fine of up to QR6,000, while 52 other violations, including using a phone while driving and not wearing a seatbelt, carry up to a year in prison or a fine of up to QR10,000.

item.title: The Ministry of Municipality and Hassad Food launched the third Winter Aswaq Festival at the 60,000-square-metre Umm Salal Central Market, …
item.description:
The Ministry of Municipality and Hassad Food launched the third Winter Aswaq Festival at the 60,000-square-metre Umm Salal Central Market, running daily from 8am to 8pm until 31 December. It offers dates, honey, fresh vegetables, seasonal fruit, traditional Qatari food and home-made products, with a corner for nurseries and indoor plants, a corner supporting families of wounded Gazans living in Qatar for the second year running, and interactive activities for children.

item.title: The IMF raised its 2026 growth forecast for the UAE to 0.2%, with growth accelerating to 7.3% in 2027 if regional disruption is lifted and …
item.description:
The IMF raised its 2026 growth forecast for the UAE to 0.2%, with growth accelerating to 7.3% in 2027 if regional disruption is lifted and trade and tourism recover, and non-oil GDP growing 5.4% next year after a 0.5% contraction this year. It put inflation at about 5% in 2026, easing to about 3% in 2027 and settling near 2% over the medium term.

item.title: Iran's army chief Major-General Amir Hatami said the armed forces were closely monitoring US movements after a third US aircraft carrier ar…
item.description:
Iran's army chief Major-General Amir Hatami said the armed forces were closely monitoring US movements after a third US aircraft carrier arrived in the region, warning that the response to any misstep would be "even more crushing". This followed Tuesday's strike by US jets on an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island in response to an Iranian attack on a US radar installation in Bahrain, while Tehran said its attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain answered US drone surveillance and an attack on Iranian communications towers.

item.title: Reuters reported, citing two people briefed on the meetings, that Mossad chief Roman Gofman urged US officials during a Washington visit la…
item.description:
Reuters reported, citing two people briefed on the meetings, that Mossad chief Roman Gofman urged US officials during a Washington visit last week to back renewed joint strikes on Iran, sharing intelligence on its nuclear programme and meeting CIA Director John Ratcliffe. A White House official said US economic pressure on Iran was working and major combat was unnecessary, while President Trump kept all options open; no decision has been announced.

item.title: Oil prices fell sharply on Wednesday after US Energy Information Administration data showed crude inventories rising 3.4 million barrels to…
item.description:
Oil prices fell sharply on Wednesday after US Energy Information Administration data showed crude inventories rising 3.4 million barrels to 417.8 million, against expectations of a slight build, and gasoline up 5.2 million barrels. Brent fell $2.03 (2.18%) to $91.11 a barrel and US crude $3.82 (4.44%) to $82.19 at 1:16pm New York time, with both on course for a monthly loss of about 20%, while shipping risks in Hormuz limited the decline.

item.description:
Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly witnessed the signing of contracts for the 500 MW Amunet 2 wind project at Ras Shukeir on the Red Sea, a $650 million investment by the UAE's AMEA Power with Power China International and Power China Huadong. item.title: The Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities announced the discovery of a large necropolis at Tell Abu Billo in Menoufia, within the ancient cit…
item.description:
The Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities announced the discovery of a large necropolis at Tell Abu Billo in Menoufia, within the ancient city of Terenouthis on the eastern edge of Wadi El Natrun, holding hundreds of stone and pottery coffins and human burials dating mostly to the early Ptolemaic period (3rd–2nd centuries BC), with some from the Late Period. The mission found gold tongues, an earring, a pendant, gold sheets, scarabs and ushabti figurines, and Supreme Council of Antiquities chief Hisham El-Leithy called it the first of its kind at the site in burial density.
Sources: Al Ain News https://al-ain.com/article/archaeological-necropolis-discovered-in-monufia · Emirates 24 https://emirates24.net/international/1811/135585/

item.description:
President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi expressed deep appreciation to the US Congress for honouring the late President Anwar Sadat with the Congressional Gold Medal, calling it recognition of his historic legacy and proof that peace is achievable when there is "political will and courage in decision-making". He called for preserving the spirit of peace as a way to prevent conflict given the regional situation and its global repercussions.

item.title: Minutes of the October FOMC meeting, released at 2pm Washington time, showed most officials favoured holding rates at 3.75% to 4% but that …
item.description:
Minutes of the October FOMC meeting, released at 2pm Washington time, showed most officials favoured holding rates at 3.75% to 4% but that "almost all participants" saw further increases as "likely appropriate" to return inflation to 2%. Many saw the AI build-out as a material source of inflation risk, and a majority cited high energy prices. Governor Christopher Waller said that if the Fed raises rates by a quarter point in December, it should signal another hike in January.
Sources: Yahoo Finance https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/fed-minutes-officials-favored-holding-rates-steady-in-october-but-they-see-hikes-ahead-195719301.html · Federal Reserve Board https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20261118a.htm · Yahoo Finance https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-november-18-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-earnings-anthropic-ipo-143530588.html

item.description:
Anthropic is set to price its IPO on Wednesday evening New York time, offering 825 million shares at $70 to $78, potentially raising up to $64.3 billion at a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, with trading due to start on Thursday on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. item.title: Gold slumped more than 3% to $3,744.60 an ounce at 1:45pm New York time after touching $3,731.10, a 14-month low, while silver fell more th…
item.description:
Gold slumped more than 3% to $3,744.60 an ounce at 1:45pm New York time after touching $3,731.10, a 14-month low, while silver fell more than 4.5% to $45.19. Both were weighed down by the dollar index hitting a year-to-date high and rising real yields, as markets fully price a December US rate hike; Goldman Sachs cut its year-end gold forecast to $4,150.
Sources: Forbes https://www.forbes.com/sites/conormurray/2026/11/18/gold-price-slumps-3-as-silver-also-tumbles-metals-hit-14-month-low/ · Ecofin Agency https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-industry/1811-60924-gold-falls-to-lowest-in-more-than-a-year-as-fed-rate-bets-build

item.title: Chinese President Xi Jinping personally greeted US President Donald Trump at Shenzhen's Bao'an airport with a handshake and embrace, a firs…
item.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping personally greeted US President Donald Trump at Shenzhen's Bao'an airport with a handshake and embrace, a first for him in office, and Trump shook hands with Russian President Vladimir Putin at the APEC welcome banquet in the evening. The three leaders hold their first trilateral summit on Thursday on the Iran war, Ukraine and strategic stability, alongside two Trump–Xi economic meetings, amid low expectations of concrete breakthroughs and ahead of the trade truce's expiry on 10 January 2027.
Sources: International Business Times AU https://www.ibtimes.com.au/xi-welcomes-trump-shenzhen-trilateral-talks-1878852 · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/what-is-trump-hoping-to-achieve-at-apec-meeting-in-china
